principles: Do not declare success from train mAP.
Use source-held-out validation plus final frozen external benchmark.
Check no catastrophic regression on ant2.

reasonableInitialCriteria.internalValidation: ants_v2 source-held-out validation should be credible across indoor/outdoor domains.
reasonableInitialCriteria.Seq0001: center recall should improve over 0.6672 or remain comparable while standard mAP does not regress meaningfully.
reasonableInitialCriteria.Seq0006: center recall should improve over 0.6217 and standard mAP50 should improve over 0.2868 if outdoor data is included.
reasonableInitialCriteria.ant2Regression: No catastrophic regression on obvious ant2 detections.
